description.value: Comor is a well-established Vancouver multi-sport retailer with a substantial cycling department covering bikes, apparel, accessories, and components, as well as a dedicated bike service and repair operation. Located on West 4th Avenue in the cycling-friendly Kitsilano neighbourhood, the shop also offers Retül 3D motion capture bike fitting — a premium service rarely found outside major cycling centres. A Comor Cycling Club and bike rentals round out the offering, making this a practical stop for touring cyclists needing gear, repairs, or a fit adjustment.
